function.name: w7tp_cloud_compute_gateway
function.description: Invoke the W7TP 8D Gateway to offload complex reasoning or code generation to cloud compute. Constructs an 8D_GENERATIVE_TRANSFER_REQUEST. It does NOT execute code or modify local files directly.

task_intent.description: A clear, context-reduced intent of what needs to be generated or analyzed.

manifest_index_refs.description: List of relative file paths relevant to this task. The gateway will supply only these specific files to the cloud.

candidate_only.description: Must strictly be set to true. Enforces that cloud response is a candidate and not an auto-land command.
